title: linear fetch_teams
description: One record per Linear team. The payload is the connector's TeamNode re-encoded, so every key is always present and nothing else is.

key.description: Team key, the prefix of issue identifiers, such as ENG.

description.description: Team description. Empty string when unset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the team, such as Europe/London.

createdAt.description: When the team was created. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

updatedAt.description: When the team last changed. Also the DataDate. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

archivedAt.description: When the entity was archived, or null.
